rules.question: Does this timing need hitting?
rules.decision: D301 (reverses D13 and the free squeeze-in of D51 question 4)

owner_lines.line_text: inline bool timing_needs_hitting(double difficulty_ms) { return difficulty_ms >= 0.0; }

must_match: inline bool early_fill_needs_timing(double e_offset) { return early_fill_difficulty(e_offset) >= 0.0; }
must_not_match: inline bool timing_reaches_floor(double ms, double floor_ms) { return ms >= floor_ms; }
rules.note: A second copy of "a timing of 0.0 ms must still be hit". Call timing_needs_hitting. Tests are out of scope because they pin figures against 0 on purpose. Decided by: D301
